_doc: Below decks (systems/belowDecks.js plans it, world/innerMap/belowDecks.js lays it, ui/innerMapBelowDecks.js runs it). The rooms under the deck, bow to stern: crew berths (hammocks), the galley, the hold (the ladder up to the hatch), the captain's cabin — sized by the hull (her crewRequired and cargoCapacity). An open boat (crew at or below openBoatCrew) has none; a small one (crew at or below smallCrew) a hold and a cuddy, the stove among the hammocks. The hold shows her cargo: each good as crates, barrels or sacks (cargoKinds; crate otherwise), in proportion to how full she is. meals: the hours the off-watch hands eat in the galley (half the mess each half hour); the cook keeps the galley from cookHours[0] to cookHours[1]; the navigator works the charts in the cabin in chartHours. maxExtras: the most of the hands beyond the deck's roster shown below.

eat: Pass the biscuit — mind the weevils.
Cook's outdone himself. Never thought I'd say it.
Eat up, the watch is called soon.
cook: Out of my galley unless you're carrying water.
Who's been at the dried peas?
charts: By my reckoning we're making better than four knots.
The log line says one thing, the stars another.
Mind the chart, Captain — the ink's wet.
tend: Keep him drinking. The fever breaks or he does.
Lime juice, if we had any.
Don't crowd them. They need air.
sick: I'll be up for my watch, Captain. Honest.
stow: Shifted in the night, this lot.
mend: Needle and palm — the sailor's other trade.
Below's the only dry place on her.
dice: That's my grog ration you're betting.
